title: Consolidated JSON output
description: The consolidated JSON output of one consolidation, such as the file a test command writes for `-fJ <path>`. It is one object, the root, whose absent values are left out rather than written as `null`.

root.description: The root of the JSON output: the consolidation as a whole, holding its modules. Its `outcome` and `failures` are present together or not at all.

kind.description: The node's kind, always `root` for the root.

scalaTestVersion.description: The version of the release of this fork that wrote the JSON output, such as `3.2.20`. The format may change between releases, so read the output against that release's documentation.

buildTool.description: The build tool that started the runs and its running version. Absent where the consolidation library's caller gives no build tool.

moduleSelectors.description: Each module selector the test command was given, with the test modules it resolved to. Empty where none was given.

outcome.description: The root's outcome, `aborted`, present only where a failure is attached to the root. No outcome is rolled up from the modules.

failures.description: The failures attached to the root: those of no single module, such as a failure of the test command itself. Absent where none is attached.

startedAt.description: The root's start time, which the consolidation library's caller gives. Absent where the caller gives none.

endedAt.description: The root's end time, which the consolidation library's caller gives. Absent where the caller gives none.

duration.description: `endedAt` less `startedAt`. Absent unless both are present.

contents.description: The root's modules. Empty where there are none.

output.description: The output captured against the root rather than against any module or run, in the order it was written. Absent where there is none.

buildTool.description: The build tool that started the runs, and its running version.

name.description: The build tool's name, `Mill` under the test command.

version.description: The running version of the build tool, such as `1.3.1`.

moduleSelector.description: One module selector as the build tool was given it, with the test modules it resolved to.

selector.description: The module selector as given, such as `__.test`.

modules.description: The module names of the test modules the module selector resolved to.

failure.description: A failure attached to the root or to a module: one that belongs to no run, such as laying out a fork group or starting a worker failing. A failure attached to a module is not prefixed with that module's name, though text from the build tool that it holds, such as a task name, can name the module.

message.description: The failure's text, such as `Starting worker 0 of fork group 1 failed: …`.

module.description: A module: a build tool's unit of build whose tests produced the runs it holds. Its `outcome` and `failures` are present together or not at all.

kind.description: The node's kind, always `module` for a module.

name.description: The module's name as its build tool writes it, such as `core.test` for a Mill module.

outcome.description: The module's outcome, `aborted`, present only where a failure is attached to the module. No outcome is rolled up from the module's runs.

failures.description: The failures attached to the module, such as its tests not starting or its class globs matching no test. Absent where none is attached.

startedAt.description: The module's start time, which the consolidation library's caller gives. Absent where the caller gives none.

endedAt.description: The module's end time, which the consolidation library's caller gives. Absent where the caller gives none.

duration.description: `endedAt` less `startedAt`. Absent unless both are present.

contents.description: The module's run nodes, one for each of its runs. Empty where it has none.

output.description: The output captured against the module rather than against any of its runs, such as what the build tool's test discovery wrote for the module, in the order it was written. Absent where there is none.

run.description: A run node: one run's own state, including how the run ended, and its top-level suites. A key is absent where the run never reported the event that supplies it.

kind.description: The node's kind, always `run` for a run node.

number.description: The run's number, unique within its module and counted from 1. Runs given a worker are numbered by fork group, then by the worker's index within its fork group.

forkGroup.description: The 0-based position of the run's fork group among the fork groups the module's `testForkGrouping` gives. Absent where the consolidation library's caller gives the run no fork group.

testCount.description: The expected test count of the run's `RunStarting`. Absent where that count is 0, as it is under Mill, or where the run reported no `RunStarting`.

configMap.description: The config map of the run's `RunStarting`. Absent where the run reported no `RunStarting`.

discovery.description: The run's discovery of its suites. Absent unless the run reported both `DiscoveryStarting` and `DiscoveryCompleted`.

outcome.description: The run's outcome where it aborted or stopped. Absent where the run completed, or where its event stream does not record how it ended.

message.description: The message of the run's `RunAborted`. Absent where the run reported no `RunAborted`.

throwable.description: The throwable of the run's `RunAborted`. Absent where the run reported no `RunAborted`, or where that event carries none.

endedAt.description: The time of the run's `RunCompleted`, `RunStopped` or `RunAborted`. Absent on a run that does not finish.

duration.description: The duration that the run's `RunCompleted`, `RunStopped` or `RunAborted` carries. Absent where that event carries none.

summary.description: The summary that the run's `RunCompleted`, `RunStopped` or `RunAborted` carries. Absent where that event carries none.

contents.description: The run's top-level suites. Empty where it has none.

output.description: The messages sent outside any suite and the output captured against the run, in one sequence in the order they were received. Absent where there is none.

configMap.description: A run's config map, each entry's value written as its `toString`.

discovery.description: A run's discovery of its suites, from its `DiscoveryStarting` and `DiscoveryCompleted`.

duration.description: The duration that the run's `DiscoveryCompleted` carries. Absent where it carries none.

summary.description: ScalaTest's own counts for a run, as its closing event's summary gives them.

testsSucceededCount.description: The number of tests that succeeded.

testsFailedCount.description: The number of tests that failed.

testsIgnoredCount.description: The number of tests that were ignored.

testsPendingCount.description: The number of tests that were pending.

testsCanceledCount.description: The number of tests that were canceled.

suitesCompletedCount.description: The number of suites that completed.

suitesAbortedCount.description: The number of suites that aborted.

scopesPendingCount.description: The number of scopes that were pending.

testNode.description: A suite, scope or test: one execution of it, so a node that ran more than once is one node for each time it ran. No node's outcome is rolled up from its children.

name.description: The node's name: a suite's suite name, or a scope's or test's own text without that of the scopes around it. It is never ScalaTest's joined test name.

label.description: A scope's or test's label, such as `when b` or `- should c`, without its indentation. Present on every scope and test, and absent on a suite.

suiteId.description: A suite's suite ID. Present on every suite, and absent on a scope or test.

location.description: Where the node is: for a suite, its class name and the source file its own scopes and tests share; for a scope or test, the location its opening or closing event gives. Always present on a suite, and absent on a scope or test whose events give none.

outcome.description: How the node ended, in ScalaTest's spelling: a test's may be any of these, a scope's `pending` or `aborted`, and a suite's `aborted`. Absent where the node has none, as on a suite that completed or a node its run left open.

reason.description: Why the node aborted, `notRun`, on a node that never started: no event reports it or any node below it. Its `outcome` is `aborted`.

message.description: The message of the `TestFailed`, `TestCanceled` or `SuiteAborted` that closed the node. Absent where no such event closed it.

throwable.description: The throwable of the `TestFailed`, `TestCanceled` or `SuiteAborted` that closed the node. Absent where no such event closed it, or where that event carries none.

startedAt.description: The time of the node's `SuiteStarting`, `ScopeOpened` or `TestStarting`. Absent on a node that never started.

endedAt.description: The time of the event that closed the node or, for an aborted node with no closing event of its own, of the `SuiteAborted` or `RunAborted` that aborted it. Absent where there is none of these.

duration.description: For a suite or test, the duration its closing event carries; for a scope, or a node with no closing event of its own, `endedAt` less `startedAt`. Absent where neither is known.

threadName.description: The thread of the event that opened the node, else of the event that closed it. Absent on a scope, and on a suite or test with neither event.

contents.description: The node's children: a suite's nested suites, scopes and tests, a scope's scopes and tests, or the suites a test ran. Empty where it has none.

output.description: The node's messages, in the order they were sent. Absent where there are none.

message.description: A message: one `info`, `alert`, `note` or `markup` call's `InfoProvided`, `AlertProvided`, `NoteProvided` or `MarkupProvided`, as an item of an `output`.
The message's text; for a `markup`, the `MarkupProvided`'s `text`.

at.description: The time the message was sent.

location.description: The location the message carries. Absent where it carries none.

throwable.description: The throwable the message carries. Absent where it carries none, and always on a `markup`.

threadName.description: The thread that sent the message. Present only where it differs from its node's `threadName`, or the node has none, as on a run node.

capturedOutput.description: A piece of captured output: one line captured from a process's stdout or stderr, as an item of an `output`. Joined in order, the `text` of one stream's items in an `output` is what was captured from that stream.

kind.description: The item's kind, always `stdio` for captured output.

stream.description: The stream the line was captured from: `stdout` or `stderr`.

text.description: The line as the process wrote it, with its line terminator where it has one.

throwable.description: A throwable record: a throwable with its cause and suppressed throwables, each recorded in full the first time it appears within the record.

id.description: The throwable's number, from 1, unique within one record. A `ref` within the same record names it.

className.description: The throwable's fully qualified class name.

message.description: The throwable's `getMessage`. Absent where it is `null`.

location.description: For a throwable mixing in `org.scalatest.exceptions.StackDepth`, such as `TestFailedException`, the failed code's file and line, each where known. Absent for any other throwable, and where neither is known.

stackTrace.description: For a throwable not mixing in `StackDepth`, every frame of its stack trace, innermost call first. Absent for a throwable mixing in `StackDepth`.

cause.description: The throwable's cause, recorded the same way, or a `ref` where it already appears in the record. Absent where there is none.

suppressed.description: The throwable's suppressed throwables, each recorded the same way, or a `ref` where it already appears in the record. Absent where there are none.

linkedThrowable.description: A cause or suppressed throwable: recorded in full, or a `ref` to the same throwable recorded earlier within the record.

throwableRef.description: A throwable already recorded within the same record, which ends any cycle. Only the same object counts, never an equal one.

stackFrame.description: One frame of a throwable's stack trace.

className.description: The fully qualified name of the class holding the frame's method.

methodName.description: The name of the frame's method.

fileName.description: The name of the frame's source file. Absent where it is unknown.

lineNumber.description: The frame's line number. Absent where it is unknown, which Java gives as a negative number.

isNative.description: `true` where the frame's method is native. Absent otherwise.

location.description: Where a node or message is, folded from ScalaTest's `Location`: `TopOfClass` gives `className`, `TopOfMethod` gives `className` and `methodId`, and `LineInFile` gives `filePath` or `fileName` and `lineNumber`. Each key is present only where known, and `filePath` and `fileName` never both.

className.description: The fully qualified name of the class.

methodId.description: The method's ID, as `TopOfMethod` gives it, such as `def adds(): Unit`.

filePath.description: The source file's path as recorded, usually absolute. Written where ScalaTest has the path.

fileName.description: The source file's name, written only where ScalaTest has no path, as where the code was compiled without `SCALACTIC_FILL_FILE_PATHNAMES` set to `yes`.

lineNumber.description: The line number in the source file.

failedCodeLocation.description: The failed code's file and line, as a throwable mixing in `org.scalatest.exceptions.StackDepth` gives them. Each key is present only where known, and `filePath` and `fileName` never both.

filePath.description: The source file's path as recorded, usually absolute. Written where ScalaTest has the path.

fileName.description: The source file's name, written only where ScalaTest has no path, as where the code was compiled without `SCALACTIC_FILL_FILE_PATHNAMES` set to `yes`.

lineNumber.description: The line number of the failed code.

epochMillis.description: A point in time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

milliseconds.description: A length of time, in milliseconds.
